script.problem: The one line is more than one sentence.

terra.problem: “God judges the wise of Edom” says the mighty men of Teman will be cut down. Obadiah 1:9 says they will be terrified and that everyone in the mountains of Esau will be cut down; it does not explicitly say the mighty men will be cut down.
“The kingdom belongs to the LORD” describes deliverers ascending Mount Zion, not the mountains of Esau. They will rule over the mountains of Esau, but the verse does not place the deliverers there.
